title: A Call to Return to the Lord

questions.question: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to the prophet Zechariah, the son of...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 1:1 (ESV): "In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to the prophet Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, son of Iddo, saying,"

questions.question: "The Lord was very angry with your..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 1:2 (ESV): "The Lord was very angry with your fathers."

questions.question: Therefore say to them, Thus declares the Lord of hosts: "Return to me, says the Lord of hosts, and I will..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 1:3 (ESV): "Return to me, says the Lord of hosts, and I will return to you, says the Lord of hosts."

questions.question: "Do not be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets cried out, 'Return from your evil ways and from your evil deeds.' But they did not hear or..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 1:4 (ESV): "But they did not hear or pay attention to me, declares the Lord."

questions.question: "Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever? But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not overtake your..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 1:6 (ESV): "But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not overtake your fathers?"

questions.question: In Zechariah's first vision, he saw a man riding on a...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 1:8 (ESV): "I saw in the night, and behold, a man riding on a red horse!"

questions.question: Where was the man on the red horse standing?
options: Among the myrtle trees in the glen
questions.correctAnswer: Among the myrtle trees in the glen
questions.explanation: Zechariah 1:8 (ESV): "He was standing among the myrtle trees in the glen,"

questions.question: Behind the man on the red horse were other horses. What colors were they?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 1:8 (ESV): "and behind him were red, sorrel, and white horses."

questions.question: The man standing among the myrtle trees answered, "These are they whom the Lord has sent to..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 1:10 (ESV): "These are they whom the Lord has sent to patrol the earth."

questions.question: The riders reported to the angel of the Lord, "We have patrolled the earth, and behold, all the earth rests and is..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 1:11 (ESV): "We have patrolled the earth, and behold, all the earth rests and is at peace."

questions.question: Then the angel of the Lord said, "O Lord of hosts, how long will you have no mercy on Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, against which you have been angry these..."
And the Lord answered gracious and comforting words to the...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 1:13 (ESV): "And the Lord answered gracious and comforting words to the angel who talked with me."

questions.question: So the angel who talked with me said to me, "Cry out, Thus says the Lord of hosts: I am exceedingly jealous for Jerusalem and for..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 1:14 (ESV): "I am exceedingly jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion."

questions.question: In Zechariah's next vision, he looked up and saw four...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 1:18 (ESV): "And I lifted my eyes and saw, and behold, four horns!"

questions.question: What did the four horns represent?
options: Horns that scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem
The four corners of the earth
Four nations that served the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Horns that scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem
questions.explanation: Zechariah 1:19 (ESV): "These are the horns that have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem."
